bank.retain_mission: This bank holds durable knowledge for the orto software project. Always extract: architectural decisions and trade-offs, coding standards and conventions, domain invariants, API design choices, tech stack facts, module boundaries, operational constraints, and explicit ADRs or decision records. Ignore: transient debugging output, one-off chat notes, generated lockfile noise, secrets/credentials, and ephemeral WIP comments.
bank.observations_mission: Synthesize stable facts about orto: tech stack, architecture patterns, team conventions, domain vocabulary, and how the codebase is organized. Prefer long-lived project truths over session-specific details.
bank.reflect_mission: You are the durable project memory for orto. When reflecting, prefer established architecture, ADRs, coding standards, and domain invariants. Cite provenance when recalling decisions. Do not invent conventions that are not in the bank.

mental_models.name: Project Context
mental_models.source_query: Summarize orto only from retained memories: purpose, that it is a TypeScript/Node CLI for Hindsight memory banks, main pipeline stages (scan, extract, seed, prune, integration), and local-first conventions. Do not invent languages, frameworks, or infrastructure (for example Python, Django, React, Kubernetes) unless a memory states them as the product stack. Prefer README and architecture docs over incidental mentions of archived scripts or dogfood notes.

mental_models.name: Architecture Decisions
mental_models.source_query: What architectural decisions have been made for orto, including trade-offs and rationale?

mental_models.name: Coding Standards
mental_models.source_query: What coding standards, style rules, and engineering practices should agents follow in orto?

mental_models.name: Seed and Sync Playbook
mental_models.source_query: How should agents and developers keep the orto Hindsight bank current: seed vs store vs prune, dry-run, incremental manifests, and what not to treat as a file-upload sync?

mental_models.name: Secrets and Safety
mental_models.source_query: How does orto keep secrets and sensitive data out of the bank: scanner denylist, allowlist, Jev secret checks, and what must never be retained?

mental_models.name: Jev Judgment Layer
mental_models.source_query: What is Orto's optional Jev judgment layer: when to use --judge jev, what it decides before retain, how it differs from Hindsight's recall reranker, and what it must not do?

mental_models.name: Agent and MCP Wiring
mental_models.source_query: How do agents connect to the orto project bank via MCP: URL shape, ORTO_HINDSIGHT_API_KEY, harness configs, and when to prefer reflect or mental models vs recall?

mental_models.name: CLI Module Map
mental_models.source_query: Where should Orto CLI logic live: commands vs scanner, extractor, seeder, providers/hindsight, judge, integration, docker, and config? What must not be collapsed into commands/ or a single opaque pipeline?

mental_models.name: Testing and Verification
mental_models.source_query: How should agents verify Orto changes: unit tests for domain logic, dry-run for mutating commands, build/typecheck expectations, and what not to over-test?

mental_models.name: Store Allowlist Workflow
mental_models.source_query: After bootstrap, how should developers keep the bank current with orto store: allowlist vs seed scan, --files, --propose-adopt, dry-run, and when to use store instead of seed?

mental_models.name: Prune Hygiene
mental_models.source_query: When and how should orto prune be used: path-gone, section-gone, explicit document-id, tombstones, dry-run, and how prune relates to seed/store after renames or heading changes?

mental_models.name: Local Hindsight Ops
mental_models.source_query: How does local Hindsight work with Orto: bank id vs Docker container name, orto docker helpers, API key env vars, backup/export, upgrade, and default localhost URL?

mental_models.name: Errors and DX
mental_models.source_query: What error-handling and DX conventions should Orto follow: OrtoError with actionable hints, --dry-run for mutating/network commands, fail-fast user vs system errors, and predictable CLI behavior?

directives.name: prefer-durable-sources
directives.content: Prefer ADRs, architecture docs, standards, and AGENTS.md over chat history or ephemeral notes when answering project questions.

directives.name: cite-provenance
directives.content: When recalling a decision or standard, mention the source document or ADR if known.

directives.name: do-not-invent-conventions
directives.content: Do not invent coding conventions or architecture rules that are not present in the bank. If unsure, say so.

directives.name: local-first
directives.content: Assume local-first and self-hostable defaults unless the bank explicitly documents a cloud requirement.
